issues.title: Organization Schema

issues.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD schema with name, logo, and contact info to help AI identify your business.
issues.explanation: Your site is missing Organization schema (JSON-LD). AI assistants use this to identify your business entity, connect your pages, and cite you by name. Without it, AI may not trust or attribute content correctly. Fix: Add a JSON-LD script with @type: 'Organization', including name, url, logo, and contactPoint.

issues.title: llms.txt
issues.evidence: docs.github.com: GET https://docs.github.com/llms.txt returned 404 (file does not exist). Checked 20 crawled pages — none reference an llms.txt.
issues.recommendation: Add a /llms.txt file to guide AI crawlers. Include a site description and links to key pages.
issues.fixCode:
# GitHub Docs

> A short description of GitHub Docs and what the site offers.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://docs.github.com/)
- [About](https://docs.github.com/about)
- [Contact](https://docs.github.com/contact)
- [Products](https://docs.github.com/products)
issues.explanation: Your site doesn't have an llms.txt file. This emerging standard helps AI crawlers understand your site's structure and prioritize important content. Fix: Create a /llms.txt file starting with '# Your Site Name' followed by a brief description and links to your key pages.

issues.title: robots.txt

issues.recommendation: Add a robots.txt file to guide AI and search crawlers.

issues.recommendation: AI search engines extract the first quotable passage and cite it as an answer. Your homepage opens with brand language instead of a direct answer — ChatGPT and Perplexity can't find a passage to cite, so they skip your site entirely. Fix: rewrite the opening paragraph to lead with what you do for whom, ideally with a specific number or outcome. Example: 'We help [who] achieve [result] by [method].'
issues.fixCode:
## Fix: Rewrite your opening paragraph

### Current opening (brand-first):
```
Skip to main content GitHub Docs Version: Free, Pro, & Team Search or ask Copilot Search or ask Copilot Select language: current language is English S...
```

### Suggested opening (answer-first):
```
GitHub Docs helps [your target customer] [achieve specific result] by [your unique method]. [One supporting stat or proof point.]
```

**Why this matters:** AI search engines scan the first 100 words for a quotable answer. If they find a direct statement, they cite it. If they find brand language, they skip the page. This single change can double your AI citation rate.
issues.explanation: Issue: Answer-Block Detectability. This finding suggests an area for improvement in your site's AI citation readiness. Addressing it can increase visibility in AI search results.
